messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 95th latency and dropped request rate detected in eu-west-1 inference pool (gpu-pool-3). Autoscaler activity spike + unexpected node drain. Paging on-call.
Samir: Seeing ingress errors and queued requests backing up. Rolling 503s for some customers. Investigating autoscaler logs now.
Maria: I’m pulling the autoscaler events. Noticing repeated scale-downs of gpu-pool-3 over last 6m, triggered by metric 'free_gpu_memory_pct' hitting threshold briefly.
Jen: Any customer-facing impact? CS pinged?
Customer Success: We have 3 customers reporting higher latency for embeddings in EU. Two are on dedicated capacity, one hosted. Escalated to priority.
Ali: Reassigning @oncall-engineer. Can you confirm if this is a misfiring scale-down or an actual host preemption?
oncall-engineer: Oncall here. Looking at node lifecycle, I see k8s evictions from Spot termination + autoscaler interpreted spike as sustained low utilization -> aggressive downscale. Looks like a metric smoothing/aggregation bug between vm-metrics-exporter and autoscaler.
Samir: Confirmed: vm-metrics-exporter emits zero for free_gpu_memory_pct when there's transient OOM on driver, which the scaler treats as underutilized -> scales down. Bad negative feedback loop.
Maria: Temporarily pausing autoscaler for gpu-pool-3 to stop churn. Running: `kubectl annotate hpa gpu-pool-3 autoscaler.kubernetes.io/paused=true` and set minReplicas=2. Will monitor queue.
oncall-engineer: Done. Queues stopped growing but latency still elevated for active requests. Initiating targeted warm-up (spin a few instances, priming KV caches).
Infra-Bot: Warm-up jobs submitted to fleet: warmup-job/eu-warm-1739802468. ETA ~90s.
Priya: Triggering fallback routing to eu-west-2 for non-dedicated hosted traffic to reduce customer impact. Adding rate limit on embeddings route for hosted tier to contain burst.
Samir: For dedicated customers in eu-west-1, we should failover to tenant-specific reserved pools where configured. Jen, can you coordinate CS comms for those two dedicated customers?
Jen: Will do. Drafting a message: "We're mitigating elevated latency by temporarily pausing autoscaler and routing some traffic to other regions. Team working on root cause and will follow up with timeline." Send in ~10m after more stabilization.
OPS-Lead: Good. Create incident bridge if not already. Assign owner for postmortem and remediation tickets.
Samir: Bridge is up: https://meet.example.com/bridge/infra-1739802468
oncall-engineer: Quick mitigation summary: paused autoscaler for gpu-pool-3, increased minReplicas to 2, launched warmup jobs, activated cross-region routing for hosted, informed CS. Immediate customer impact reduced. Need follow-ups:
- remediation-1: fix vm-metrics-exporter zero-emission edge-case (owner: Ali, due: 2026-03-20)
- remediation-2: add smoothing/windowing in autoscaler metric handler (owner: Maria, due: 2026-03-22)
- remediation-3: canary for autoscaler config changes + synthetic load monitor per zone (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-24)
- remediation-4: oncall runbook update for spot preemption and backoff (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-19)
Ali: Creating JIRA tickets now. JIRA: INFRA-4523, INFRA-4524, INFRA-4525, INFRA-4526.
Maria: Adding automated alert to detect oscillating scale events (>=3 up/down within 10m). Alert rule: `count(autoscaler_event{pool="gpu-pool-3"} by (pool) > 3)`. Will add to pager when tripped.
oncall-engineer: We should also add a short-circuit in routing: if local tail latency > 1200ms for 5m, shift default traffic to regional fallback. Priya will implement toggle.
Priya: Adding feature flag + runbook: fallback-toggle/region-shift with 5 min cool-down. Tests to be added to canary pipeline.
Jen: CS update sent to affected customers. They responded asking for ETA on fix for dedicated pools — told them we'll follow up after postmortem.
Customer Success: One dedicated customer asked for a postmortem; please include impact window and actions. They'll want log slices and request ids.
Samir: Log slices saved: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1739802468/eu-west-1/*. Added sample request ids in the bridge notes.
OPS-Lead: Scheduling postmortem review. Propose 2026-03-21 09:30 UTC (1h) — owners required to present remediation plan. Any objections?
Ali: Works for me.
Maria: Works.
Jen: I’ll coordinate invites and attach CS notes.
oncall-engineer: Added quick fix PR to pause autoscaler on unstable metrics (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/581). Needs review from Maria and Ali.
Ali: Reviewing now.
Infra-Bot: Autoscaler pause removed at 1739803000 after warm-up verification. Note: keep paused flag removal gated to stable metric window (>10m no oscillation).
Samir: Confirming traffic normalized; 95th latency back to baseline for most routes. Dedicated customers still verifying but CS reporting improvements.
Jen: Sending final customer update: service restored, mitigation in place, postmortem scheduled.
OPS-Lead: Capture action items in the incident tracker and link JIRA tickets. Owner check-ins due in 72h on remediation progress.
Priya: I’ll own the canary/tests and post updates to INFRA-4525.
Samir: I'll update the runbook and add a checklist for manual backfill steps.
oncall-engineer: Closing bridge. Will continue asynchronous follow-ups here. Good handoff to owners.
Customer Success: Thanks team. We’ll consolidate customer asks into one doc and send a follow-up after the postmortem.
Jen: Postmortem invite sent to infra, ops, cs, and product: 2026-03-21 09:30 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, impact, remediation plan, verification.
Samir: +1. Adding notes channel thread to link artifacts. End of thread.
__notes: generated by dataset-gen: unique evacuation/oscillation incident thread focusing on autoscaler metric zero edge-case and mitigation tracking
